name: Dalian University of Technology
supervisors: Ministry of Education (co-built with Liaoning province and Dalian city)

evidence.summary: The university’s School of Physics reports that its key laboratory for materials modification by laser, ion and electron beams held a third bilateral exchange in 2018 with the surface physics and chemistry key laboratory of the China Academy of Engineering Physics (CAEP), which CASI identifies as a national defence key laboratory researching materials for nuclear weapons; the two sides agreed to cooperate on defence basic research, military-civil fusion and joint graduate training, and the university’s defence science and technology development institute took part.
Dalian University of Technology describes itself as a national key university directly under the Ministry of Education, co-built with Liaoning province and Dalian city.
